description: Calculated on Train + Validation sets (80% of clean data) to prevent data snooping on the held-out Test Set.
decision_rationale: At MAX_LENGTH=128, 96.07% of samples are fully preserved (p95 is 121.0 tokens). Truncation is only 3.93%. Doubling sequence length from 128 to 256 quadruples the self-attention score matrix size (O(L^2) quadratic scaling) for only a 3.84% coverage gain, while end-to-end memory and runtime will be measured empirically during training.
